scope: Internal substrate logical parts; not system component registry

SUB_shared.ownership: SUB-C1 sole durable state/commit storage; C2 change admission; C3 inquiry and selection. Trials use isolated namespaces.
SUB_shared.authority: C3 reads/proposes; direct C3 durable mutation prohibited. C2 validates authority/version/bounds then requests C1 commit. Rules cannot grant themselves new authority.
SUB_shared.shape_versions: Native selectors and immutable schema/profile/transform/model/preprocessing versions; explicit unknown/unsupported/partial results. Exact wire schema remains pending.
SUB_shared.identity_scope: Scoped request/record/occurrence IDs and source epochs; payload dedup is not occurrence dedup; operational identity differs from physical truth.
SUB_shared.time_order: Preserve event/valid/source/receipt/commit/known/model time and clock uncertainty. Acquisition cursor differs from event order; gaps remain explicit.
SUB_shared.delivery_idempotency: Stable request and occurrence identities, bounded retry/status/cancel, no duplicate state effect on replay; unknown outcome remains explicit.
SUB_shared.commit_recovery: C1 commit unit contains admitted changes, dependencies, applied IDs and consumer checkpoint; C2 records no competing state log.
SUB_shared.retention: Explicit native evidence availability plus substrate retention/recovery policy. Derived state must not imply eternal replay.
SUB_shared.resource_limits: Bound page/range/query/queue/trial/acquisition/model work by declared profile and shared root budget; count retries, failures and recovery. Numerical profile pending.
SUB_shared.errors: Unknown, unavailable, unsupported, denied, stale/conflict, timeout, cancelled, partial, integrity and capacity outcomes are attributable; exact binding pending.
SUB_shared.feedback_grounding: Keep native, derived, internal and imported evidence distinct; preserve selection/dependency lineage. Acceptance and internal echoes are not independent external corroboration.
